name: @kiwa-lab/security-devsecops
description: DevSecOps test harness for kiwa v0.3 — 6 axis (SAST + SCA + Secret scan + IaC scan + DAST + Container security) unified across 6 provider (Semgrep + Trivy + Gitleaks + tfsec + OWASP ZAP + Grype)、 v0.1 semantics + v0.2 adapter に加えて **v0.3 で runSecurityAudit single entry + 4 preset (audit-all / supply-chain / specialty / threat-model) + summarizeAuditReport 集約 API を追加、 Phase 3 完成で skill 個別化を排除**、 backward compat 絶対維持で v0.1 + v0.2 API 変更 0、 KIWA_SECURITY_MODE=real で real driver env-gate opt-in。 Complements v0.2 @kiwa-lab/security (advanced runtime security: CSP + mTLS + SIEM + SLSA) with build-time / CI-time security scanning axis.

scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
scripts.test:cov: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node --coverage --coverage.provider=v8 --coverage.reporter=json --coverage.reporter=json-summary --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/**/*.js' --coverage.exclude='.vitest-dist/tests/**' --coverage.exclude='.vitest-dist/src/semantics/types.js'
